sn56.32:2.2: “Acacia” (khadira) is Senegalia catechu, whose leaves are compounded of many tiny leaflets like a fern. | “Pine” (sarala) is Pinus roxburghii. | “Myrobalan” (āmalaka) is Phyllanthus emblica, whose leaves are very small. | Read tālapakka per BJT.
sn56.32:4.2: These plants all have large, broad leaves.
